claims.text: Patient reports an allergic reaction to amoxicillin, manifesting as a rash on day three of a course.

citations.quote: Patient developed a rash on day three of the course and is allergic to amoxicillin.

claims.text: Clinician documented 'no known drug allergies' on 2026-05-02.

citations.quote: No known drug allergies. Blood pressure and weight recorded.

open_questions: When was the amoxicillin allergy first documented, given the recent rash report and prior 'no known drug allergies' note?

Was the amoxicillin course stopped or changed after the rash appeared, and when?
What other medications were active around May 2026 or August 2026 that might relate to the rash or treatment?
